headline: The PSX benchmark KSE-100 index gained 1,269.55 points, or 0.77%, on Wednesday as afternoon buying lifted the market after early selling.

card.desc: Market recovered from early selling to close higher.

caption:
The PSX benchmark KSE-100 index gained 1,269.55 points, or 0.77%, on Wednesday as afternoon buying lifted the market after early selling, Business Recorder reports. Ready market volume stood at 578.124 million shares worth Rs26.203 billion, APP adds.
